correctness.rationale: A fresh independent full 2^20 Walsh transform of the explicitly recursively enumerated 2188 length-10 nonnegative Motzkin excursions yielded exactly 67312 zero multipliers, smallest nonzero magnitude 2 and 48 weight-four zeros. A second Walsh transform of the nonzero-support indicator yielded kernel absolute sum 52163296 and square sum 1028929880064, giving projection norm 52163296/1048576 = 1630103/32768. The inspected C++17 code independently implements signed-height transfer recurrence at all 1048576 frequencies and checks three CSV certificates. Odd Motzkin counts M_4..M_9 force no zeros, whereas n=2,3 explicit witnesses give singularity. Translation-averaging arbitrary projection preserves its range and cannot increase endpoint norm, proving unrestricted optimality. All numeric claims are finite n=10; no infinite spectrum claim.
